description: An expander for complex Simpler and slim Simpler that steps through the audio files in the folder the loaded sample came from

params.text: Loads the file after the current one in the list
Loads the file before the current one in the list
Loads a file picked at random from the list

inputs.text: A trigger loads the file after the current one in the list
A trigger loads the file before the current one in the list
A voltage picks a file from the list, read as MIDI note numbers so one semitone moves on by one file
A trigger loads a file picked at random from the list

notes: the list it steps through is the audio files in the folder the expanded module's current sample came from, so a sample has to be loaded there first
